notes.zh:
- **插件的后台会话不再发通知**（#43）：心跳、QQ 机器人这类插件开的后台会话，以前每跑一轮都弹一条内容是 JSON 的通知，点进去还找不到。现在只有会话列表里看得到的会话才发通知；也不会再出现莫名其妙的“新会话”
- **每个会话一条通知**（#43）：标题是会话名，内容是最后一句回复的摘要，点开直达那个会话；打开会话后通知自动清除，多条会分组显示
- **会话免打扰**（#43）：长按会话或点“…”菜单可以设免打扰，只静音“任务完成”提醒；需要你批准、回答或解锁的请求仍会通知，免得任务一直卡着
- **Shizuku 状态说清楚**（#42）：分开显示“没装”“没启动”“没授权”“版本太旧”“可用”，每种都给出下一步怎么做，诊断信息里也写清楚
- 这版没有在真机上测试过
- 仅支持 arm64-v8a，Android 10 及以上；正式签名，可直接覆盖安装，也可以在 设置 → 关于 里直接更新
notes.en:
- **Plugin background sessions no longer notify** (#43): heartbeat / QQ-bot style plugin sessions used to post a JSON notification every round that led nowhere. Only conversations shown in the session list notify now, and stray "new conversation" entries are gone
- **One notification per conversation** (#43): titled with the conversation name, showing a short summary of the last reply; tapping opens it, opening it clears the notification, several are grouped
- **Mute a conversation** (#43): long-press or "…" menu. Mutes "task finished" alerts only; approvals, questions and unlock requests still notify so tasks don't stall
- **Clearer Shizuku status** (#42): not installed / not running / not authorized / too old / ready, each with the next step, also in diagnostics
- Not yet tested on a real device
